summary: No qualifying sponsors. All 20 base records fail at least one mandatory test on evidence published and effective on or before 2026-08-31. Six records (R1659, R4622, R8409, R9231, R7166, R6294, plus R9475) were moved out of the Dallas market by executed amendments effective 2026-08-20, and R3050 inherits the same-entity amendment applied to FIR-SPO-60522; R4732 was already Seattle. Others fail on asset class (R7745 Office), activity (R4936 announced bid), size basis (R8586 portfolio total), size range (R1794 $3.2M), date window (R2755, 2024-02-10), firm kind (R8222 property manager, R8993 broker), contact eligibility (R4342 former employee, R1915 registered agent, R9787 verification dated 2024-01-10), or admissibility of evidence (R4391 published 2026-09-03, after cutoff). The shortlist is therefore empty; this is an insufficient-qualifying-evidence outcome rather than a ranking problem.
limitations: Conclusion rests solely on the supplied S-/U- extracts; no external search, CRM or enrichment was used, and no contact emails were inferred or guessed.

Executed amendments restating market to Seattle were treated as controlling for the same entity, including duplicate records of that entity (FIR-SPO-60522 via U-R1659-4 applied to R1659, R3050 and to the SPV parent link in R4622); if any of those amendments were intended to apply only to a single property rather than the entity, up to several Dallas candidates could requalify.
U-R9231-2 (employment change, published/effective 2026-09-10) and S-R4391 (published 2026-09-03) were excluded as later-dated than the 2026-08-31 cutoff; U-R7166-3 was excluded as an unsigned draft.
R9475 lists no published business email (reported as unknown/null rather than zero); it was excluded on market grounds regardless.
Contact verification for several records is dated 2026-08-10 only in the base extract; where a record failed on market or activity, contact currency was not further probed.
Missing fields (e.g., null parent_entity_id, unpublished emails) were treated as unknown, not as confirmation of absence.
Artifact generation (comp-grid XLSX / prospect CSV) is outside this direct API control; no workbook or CSV was produced or delivered, and none should be assumed to exist.
